title: How to organise the desk drawers and pedestal | Home Office
description:
Hold the small tools you reach for without looking, and the live files you touch weekly.

This is the Desk Drawers and Pedestal in the Home Office. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
A top drawer with a divided tray holding pens that all write, one stapler, one pair of scissors point-down in its own slot, and a deep pedestal drawer of hanging files with tabs all standing in one line.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Tip the top drawer onto the cleared desk and test every pen on scrap paper.
Straighten: Daily hand tools live in the divided tray up top, hanging files fill the deep pedestal drawer, and the two nev
Shine: Vacuum the drawer bottoms, which collect eraser crumbs, loose staples, and paperclip fuzz, then wipe the runne
Safety: Scissors and the letter opener get their own slot with points facing the back of the drawer, because you reach
Standardize: Write what each drawer front holds, in the words this house actually uses, so tape and stamps are found withou
Sustain: When you sit down to pay the household bills, put back into the drawers anything that migrated out onto the de

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
One purpose per drawer, every pen in it writes, and the scissors live point-down in a fixed slot.
